home.heroEyebrow: NOOR AL AFIYA HOME HEALTH CARE
home.heroDesc: As an advanced home healthcare provider based in the Kingdom of Bahrain, NOOR AL AFIYA Home Health Care WLL offers world-class nursing care at home at affordable prices. We provide advanced home healthcare services 24/7 wherever care is needed. We provide registered nurses and caregivers, both male and female, with BSc, GNM, ANM, GDA and other paramedical qualifications, to treat and care for patients in their homes.
home.servicesDesc: Choose the home-care service that best matches your family's requirements.
home.whyHeading: Support you can feel comfortable bringing home.
home.whyDesc: Our experience is built around making home care clear, accessible and centered on the person receiving it.
home.aboutHeading: Advanced home healthcare, wherever you need us.
home.aboutP1: Established in 2016, NOOR AL AFIYA Home Health Care WLL is dedicated to delivering professional, compassionate and affordable home healthcare services across the GCC.
home.aboutP2: We bring quality nursing care to the comfort of your home, supported by qualified and experienced nursing professionals, caregivers and healthcare specialists. Our services are designed around each patient's individual condition and care requirements.
home.aboutP3: From routine nursing assistance to advanced home-based care, we focus on patient comfort, safety, dignity and well-being. With personalised care plans, regular health monitoring and appropriate medical equipment, we help families access professional healthcare support in a familiar and comfortable environment.
home.aboutCommitment: Our commitment is simple: professional care, personal attention and peace of mind for every family.

patient.title: Patient Care
patient.text: Personalized support for patients who need dependable care at home.
patient.shortDescription: Professional support for patients who need dependable care and assistance at home.
patient.description: Our patient care service is designed to support individuals who require assistance at home. Care requirements can vary from normal mobility to wheelchair, bedridden and ventilator support.
patient.formDesc: Book professional patient care at home with a quick and simple request.

elder.title: Elder Care
elder.text: Comfort-focused assistance that helps older adults stay independent at home.
elder.shortDescription: Comfort-focused care and assistance for elderly people in the familiar surroundings of home.
elder.description: Our elder care service focuses on providing respectful assistance and everyday support for elderly people while helping families arrange care according to their requirements.
elder.formDesc: Arrange comfortable and dependable elder care at home in just a few steps.

newborn.title: Newborn Care
newborn.text: Gentle, attentive support for newborn babies and their families.
newborn.shortDescription: Gentle and attentive support for newborn babies and families during the early stages of care.
newborn.description: Our newborn care service provides a structured way for families to request support based on the baby's specific care requirements.
newborn.formDesc: Tell us what support your newborn needs and choose your preferred care shift.

children.title: Children's Care
children.text: Safe and caring support tailored to the needs of children.
children.shortDescription: Safe and caring support designed around the individual needs of children.
children.description: Our children's care service allows families to request home-care support based on the child's condition and care requirements.
children.formDesc: Request caring home support for your child with a short, easy booking form.

icu.title: ICU Patient Care
icu.text: Specialized home nursing care for critically ill patients, with continuous monitoring and advanced clinical support.
icu.shortDescription: Specialized intensive care nursing at home with bedside monitoring and advanced clinical management.
icu.description: Our ICU Patient Care service brings dedicated critical care nursing directly to your home. Designed for high-dependency and post-ICU patients requiring vital monitoring, IV infusion support, and skilled clinical oversight.
icu.formDesc: Book specialized ICU and critical care nursing support at home with our experienced healthcare team.

cancer.title: Cancer Patient Care
cancer.text: Compassionate and specialized home nursing care for cancer patients, focused on comfort, safety and personalized support.
cancer.shortDescription: Compassionate oncology nursing and palliative home care supporting patients and families with dignity.
cancer.description: Our Cancer Patient Care service provides comprehensive, compassionate home nursing for oncology patients, emphasizing symptom relief, post-chemotherapy recovery, pain management, and emotional support.
cancer.formDesc: Arrange compassionate oncology and palliative nursing care at home tailored to the patient's dignity and comfort.

ventilator.title: Ventilator Patient Care
ventilator.text: Professional home nursing support for ventilator-dependent patients, with respiratory care and continuous monitoring.
ventilator.shortDescription: Expert respiratory nursing for patients receiving mechanical ventilation and tracheostomy care at home.
ventilator.description: Our Ventilator Patient Care service provides skilled respiratory home nursing for tracheostomy and ventilator-dependent patients, ensuring diligent airway maintenance, ventilator monitoring, and patient comfort.
ventilator.formDesc: Request dedicated ventilator and respiratory nursing care at home with qualified clinical supervision.

bloodCollection.title: Blood Collection Service
bloodCollection.text: Convenient and safe blood sample collection at home by qualified nursing professionals.
bloodCollection.shortDescription: Safe, sterile, and certified blood sample collection at your home with rapid laboratory delivery.
bloodCollection.description: Our Blood Collection Service brings licensed phlebotomy nurses to your doorstep across Bahrain for gentle, safe, and sterile blood drawing for routine and specialized lab investigations.
features: Certified phlebotomy nurses at your doorstep
Wide range of diagnostic blood tests
bloodCollection.formDesc: Schedule certified phlebotomy nurses to collect blood samples safely and comfortably at your home.

about.heroDesc: An advanced home healthcare provider established in 2016, committed to delivering professional, compassionate and affordable healthcare services across the GCC.
about.introHeading: Professional home healthcare, with a human approach.
about.introP1: NOOR AL AFIYA Home Health Care WLL is an advanced home healthcare provider established in 2016, with a commitment to delivering professional, compassionate and affordable healthcare services across the GCC.
about.introP2: Our mission is to make quality healthcare accessible beyond hospital walls by bringing professional nursing care and personalised support directly to patients in their homes.
about.introP3: We understand that caring for a loved one requires trust, attention and professional expertise. Our team works to provide dependable healthcare support while respecting every patient's comfort, dignity and individual needs.
about.approachHeading: Structured nursing care, tailored to each patient.
about.approachP1: Unlike basic home assistance, our approach focuses on providing structured nursing care according to each patient's medical condition and care requirements.
about.approachP2: Our services are supported by qualified nursing professionals, caregivers and other healthcare personnel, including professionals with BSc Nursing, GNM, ANM and relevant caregiver and paramedical qualifications.
about.approachP3: We develop individualised care plans based on the patient's condition and the guidance of their treating healthcare professionals.
about.compassionDesc: We place the patient's comfort, dignity and well-being at the heart of every care plan.
about.professionalismDesc: Qualified nursing professionals and caregivers deliver structured, clinically informed care.
about.personalisedDesc: Individualised care plans designed around each patient's specific condition and needs.
about.advancedHeading: A proper care environment, set up at home.
about.advancedDesc: We help families arrange suitable home healthcare environments with appropriate medical equipment and patient-care facilities.
about.card1Desc: Hospital-style beds, mattresses and mobility assistance equipment as required.
about.card2Desc: Medical equipment for nursing procedures, wound care and dressing as clinically required.
about.card3Desc: Equipment and support arrangements for advanced home-based care needs.
about.card4Desc: Patient-care arrangements coordinated before the service begins, tailored to individual needs.
about.monitoringHeading: Continuity of care, every step of the way.
about.monitoringP1: Patient safety and continuity of care are central to our approach. Our care team maintains regular records of relevant patient observations and health updates to help families and treating healthcare professionals understand changes in the patient's condition.
about.monitoringP2: Our supervisory team reviews patient-care progress and coordinates additional professional support when required. Depending on the patient's needs and availability, we can also help arrange consultations or services from doctors, physiotherapists and dieticians.
about.healthRecordsDesc: Consistent monitoring and documentation of relevant patient observations and updates.
about.supervisoryDesc: Our supervisory team reviews progress and coordinates additional support when needed.
about.specialistDesc: We can help arrange consultations with doctors, physiotherapists and dieticians.
about.commitmentHeading: Professional care. Personal attention. Peace of mind.
about.commitmentP1: We believe that the right home environment, professional nursing support, emotional encouragement and appropriate medical guidance can make a meaningful difference to a patient's care experience.
about.commitmentP2: Our experienced team is committed to providing attentive and responsible care while keeping families informed about their loved one's progress.
about.commitmentDisclaimer: Home healthcare is not a replacement for emergency hospital treatment. Our services are provided according to the patient's needs and appropriate medical guidance, with hospital referral when necessary.
about.commitmentTagline: NOOR AL AFIYA – Bringing professional healthcare closer to home since 2016.
